slots.contributor_name: Smith College. Department of Biological Sciences.

expectedSql:
SELECT ii.hrid,
       ii1.id AS item_id,
       ii.dates__date1 AS publication_date,
       ii.title
FROM inventory.instance__t ii
JOIN inventory.instance__t__contributors itc
  ON itc.id = ii.id
JOIN inventory.contributor_name_type__t icnt
  ON icnt.id = itc.contributors__contributor_name_type_id
JOIN inventory.holdings_record__t ih
  ON ih.instance_id = ii.id
JOIN inventory.item__t ii1
  ON ii1.holdings_record_id = ih.id
JOIN inventory.location__t il
  ON il.id = ii1.effective_location_id
JOIN inventory.loclibrary__t il1
  ON il1.id = il.library_id
JOIN inventory.loccampus__t ic
  ON ic.id = il1.campus_id
JOIN inventory.material_type__t imt
  ON imt.id = ii1.material_type_id
WHERE ic.name ILIKE :p0 AND itc.contributors__name ILIKE :p1 AND icnt.name ILIKE :p2 AND imt.name ILIKE :p3
LIMIT 100
